observations: Photo 0: close-up of a blue PS4 Slim top shell, Days-of-Play style design with PlayStation button icons, console wrapped tightly in cling film, no cables or screen visible.
Photo 1: same blue wrapped console on a patterned ottoman, with a grey/blue camo DualShock controller placed in front; no games, discs, box, or power cable shown.
Photo 2: angled shot of the same wrapped console and camo controller; watermark 'THE GAME GUY VENTURES' visible, suggesting a reseller/dealer photo rather than the actual owner's item.
No photo shows the console powered on, a system menu, game library, serial/model sticker, or any of the '10 latest games' claimed.

Seller mentions 'PES 2027' as one of the included games; this title does not exist (PES was discontinued/rebranded to eFootball in 2021), which is a significant red flag for a fabricated or copy-pasted listing.

claims.evidence: Photos show a blue Days-of-Play style PS4 Slim shell, consistent with a limited edition, but still wrapped in film with no serial or power-on confirmation.

claims.claim: Comes with 10 latest games including FIFA and PES 2027
claims.evidence: No game discs, hard drive menu, or screen is shown in any photo; 'PES 2027' is not a real released title, undermining the credibility of the claim.
Photo 1 and photo 2 show a camo-blue DualShock controller alongside the console.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal faults (HDMI port, hard drive, overheating) since it is shown wrapped and never tested on screen.
risks.proof: A video of the console powering on to the PS4 home screen with controller paired.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / worst case

risks.risk: Claimed '10 latest games' including a non-existent title (PES 2027) suggests games may not actually be installed or the listing text is copy-pasted/exaggerated.
risks.proof: Screenshot of the PS4 library/menu showing installed game icons and titles.
risks.if_unproven: priced as console only, no games included

risks.risk: No visible serial number, box, or receipt to confirm authenticity or that this is not a reported stolen/blacklisted unit.
risks.proof: Photo of the rear/bottom serial sticker and original box or proof of purchase.

risks.risk: No power cable or HDMI cable shown; may be sold without accessories needed to use it.
risks.if_unproven: priced as console+pad only, no cables

proof_requests: Video of the console powered on, showing the PS4 home screen and controller pairing.
Screenshot of the installed games library to verify the claimed 10 games.
Photo of the rear serial number plate and any box/receipt.
Photo showing power and HDMI cables included.
response.reason: The seller claims inclusion of 'PES 2027', a game that does not exist, which combined with zero proof of power-on or game library strongly suggests a fabricated or recycled listing rather than a genuine, verifiable offer.
